text:
3 months ago this site had 0 impressions on Google.

Now: ~3,500 impressions a day. Average position ~7.5.

Not viral. Not huge. But it compounds every single day.

What actually moved the graph:
• One page per real question (not per keyword)
• Every page has a working tool, not just text
• Topic hubs so Google understands the site
• No shortcuts: no bought links, no copied content

The slow, boring way works. It just needs patience.
